events.fact: Spotify OAuth authorize endpoint is https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize (or /oauth2/v2/auth), and token endpoint is https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token, supporting PKCE (S256).
As of February 2026, Spotify Development Mode limits each developer to 1 Client ID and a maximum of 5 authorized test users, and requires the app owner to have a Spotify Premium subscription.

Extended Quota Mode requires formal application and approval through the Spotify Developer Dashboard, restricted as of May 15, 2025 to established business entities with active, launched services (e.g. 250k+ monthly active users).
Spotify access tokens expire in 1 hour, and refresh tokens expire after 6 months from initial authorization (with automatic expiration if unused or revoked).
Spotify Developer Terms and Guidelines prohibit using API data to train machine learning models or AI generative models.
Development mode apps are capped at 5 authenticated users, requiring each user to be explicitly added to the app's allowlist in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Extended Quota Mode applications require an established business entity with a launched service and at least 250k MAUs, submitted via corporate form and review process taking up to 6 weeks.
